scientific_question: Which observed globin residues approach each of the four heme cofactors in human deoxyhemoglobin, and what sampled solvent-accessible area is buried when each cofactor is added to the complete globin complex at the deposited coordinates?

source.solver_input: Full unmodified deposited mmCIF, model 1 used by the declared analysis
source.private_reference_input: Independently parsed paired deposited PDB; not a solver input and not credited as an exercised solver format
source.observations: 574 protein residues in four globin chains and four HEM cofactors; water and phosphate remain in the supplied native file but are excluded by the stated analysis policy
source.lineage_review: Existing source catalog screening remains incomplete for all benchmark lineages; no training export clearance follows from task creation. The reviewed DrugDiscoveryBench endpoints use 7BUC, 7K6M and 6PGP rather than 4HHB; PromptBio source input structure accession is unspecified in permitted metadata.

benchmark_relationships.inspected_endpoint: Identify protein residues within 4.0 angstrom of a named MTX ligand in an input PDB and preserve chain/residue/name in a CSV
benchmark_relationships.adaptation: Same ligand-to-protein heavy-atom neighborhood operation on independent 4HHB HEM cofactors, with full author identities, complete residue universe and all passing atom pairs. Native input is mmCIF and output TSV, so exact PDB/CSV format endpoint remains unvalidated.

benchmark_relationships.inspected_endpoint: Ligand hydrogen-bond/salt-bridge counts with explicit chemical and angular criteria
benchmark_relationships.adaptation: Atom identity resolution and distance neighborhoods only. This task does not assign protonation, hydrogen positions, donors, acceptors, angles, hydrogen bonds or salt bridges.

frozen_method.identity: Author chain, sequence number, insertion code, residue name and atom name; retain all four chains and every HEM instance
frozen_method.selection: Model 1; protein ATOM and HETATM HEM; heavy atoms at positive occupancy; highest occupancy alternate atom then lexical alternate ID
frozen_method.contacts: All distinct protein-HEM heavy-atom pairs at inclusive 4.0 angstrom; no CA-only approximation
frozen_method.sasa: Biopython 1.88 ShrakeRupley,960 fixed golden-spiral points, 1.4 angstrom probe and explicit C/N/O/S/FE radii
frozen_method.context: Complete selected globin complex as baseline; add one HEM at a time. Other HEMs, water, phosphate and crystallographic symmetry mates excluded. Coordinates unchanged in all contexts.
frozen_method.burial: Per-partner SASA_without minus SASA_with; total is protein+HEM loss, not half the sum
frozen_method.interpretation: Observed geometric proximity and specified sampled solvent exposure; no hydrogen-bond, affinity, free-energy or apo/holo relaxation inference

artifacts.contacts.tsv: Every passing protein/HEM atom pair with full identities and distance
artifacts.residues.tsv: Every one of 574 protein residues for each of four HEMs, including zero contacts, nearest atom pair, pocket membership, count and per-residue SASA/burial
artifacts.heme_atoms.tsv: Every selected HEM heavy atom, nearest protein atom and distance, isolated/complex SASA and burial
artifacts.answer.json: Four HEM summaries with distinct residue/chain counts, pair counts, protein/HEM/total burial and nearest protein atom to iron

verification.reference: Paired-PDB fixed-column parse and independent NumPy distances/sampling-point occlusion, using full unchanged coordinates
verification.native_oracle: Biopython MMCIF2Dict, NeighborSearch and ShrakeRupley in pinned environment
verification.artifact_grader: Existing complete TableContract identity/integer/numeric checks plus complete answer rows; no LLM judge
positive_controls: Reordered TSV rows and columns with unchanged scientific content
negative_controls: Correct summaries with changed contact distance
Correct summaries with removed zero-contact residue
Use pair counts as distinct residue counts
verification.native_status: passed: independent reference, fresh native oracle, two positive and nineteen negative controls

resources.execution: Offline after pinned environment creation; existing reserved CPU only; no model or judge calls
